[[File:Offizielles_Star_Wars_Magazin_8_cover.jpg|thumb|right|260px|''Offizielles Star Wars Magazin'' #8 (14 January 1998)]]
'''''Offizielles Star Wars Magazin''''' was the German-market ''Star Wars'' magazine from Miracle Images / OZ Verlag.<ref name="oswm" /> Issues 8–11 (14 January, 15 April, 15 July and 10 October 1998) ran 66 pages at DM 7,50 and carried advertisements for a forthcoming German Premiere edition.<ref name="oswm" />

The advertisements are [[Deutsche Ausgabe STAR WARS Premiere (Offizielles Star Wars Magazin)|Deutsche Ausgabe STAR WARS Premiere]]. The cancelled Queens Games printing is [[Cancelled German release of SWCCG]]. The dated catalog is [[Magazines]].
